thread:
release-bot: Starting staged rollout: service=serving-api image=redwood/serving:1.15.0 target=3% global prebake=6m. Hooks: perf,errors.

dana: Change window OK. Is ap-south included in the 3% cohort?

release-bot: Yes  cohort is global by user_id hash; ap-south included.

rick: early signal from ap-south: p95 up from 120ms -> 340ms on a small sample at ~03:22 UTC. No error-rate spike yet.

ops-bot: dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood.internal/serving-api/rollouts/3987654321

dana: propose pause the ramp and pin ap-south to previous image while we triage. Regional pin avoids full rollback.

deploy-bot: Command: set-traffic --service serving-api --percent 3 --action pause -> OK (cmd id: p1x2).

deploy-bot: Command: pin-region --service serving-api --region ap-south --image redwood/serving:1.14.9 --reason "p95 tail uptick" -> OK (cmd id: p1x3).

rick: running a quick replay of sampled traces now, will update in ~7m.

dana: soft-stop vote: react with :thumbsup: to stop increases; :white_check_mark: to continue.

rick: :thumbsup:

dana: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Vote tally: stop=2 continue=0 -> OUTCOME: STOP. Rollout paused at 3% with ap-south pinned to 1.14.9.

release-bot: Noted  will attach triage links and mark release notes as "paused - regional pin". Next check-in in 30m or on triage update.
